¿Puedo medir productividad con mis cámar: Can I measure productivity with my existing cameras?
Qué comprobar antes de reutilizar cámara: What to check before reusing cameras to count units, measure timing and observe workflow.
Elige un evento visible: una caja que cr: Choose a visible event: a box crossing an area or an order reaching pickup. Define the beginning and end of the event. An image alone does not explain why an operation is delayed.
Comprueba que la escena sirve: Check whether the scene is usable
Revisa una muestra en condiciones normal: Review a sample during normal operation and busy hours. Look for blocked objects, reflections, low light and changes in position. Placement and image quality affect analysis; a useful surveillance camera may not show enough detail to count a product.

Como propuesta de piloto, compara el con: For a pilot, compare automated counts with manual counts over the same interval. Record false counts and missed events. Agree on acceptable error for your operational decision and repeat the test when the scene changes.

Aclara si contarás cajas, pallets o movi: Clarify whether you will count boxes, pallets or movements. Define cycle start and end events and how returns or repeated movements should be handled. Teams may interpret productivity differently if these rules are not written before measurement.
La prueba debe contemplar los cambios re: Testing should cover relevant operating changes: shifts, lighting, material buildup and partially hidden objects. Check that the event is visible. Otherwise, a different angle or another data source may be needed.
